title: fix(i18n): ru/ar count labels on seven more `=== 1` two-key values (objectui#10425)
body:
Fixes #10425
Clause-②: no

## What this does

Seven locale values sit behind a `count === 1` two-key switch. The count-not-one half of each held one noun form, which is wrong at some of the counts it serves: `ru` at 2-4 (few) and 21 (one), `ar` at 2 (two) and from 11 up. Each becomes a count label (a label, a colon, then the number), the device ruled for this family on objectui#10024, objectui#10240 and objectui#10242. The singular halves, the key sets and the call sites are unchanged. There are no `_few` / `_two` keys, because `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts` holds every pack to the `en` key set.

| key | pack | before (on `main`) | after | switch (consumer) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `list.recordCount` | ru | `COUNT записей` | `Записей: COUNT` | `totalCount === 1` (`ListView`) |
| `list.recordCount` | ar | `COUNT سجلات` | `عدد السجلات: COUNT` | `totalCount === 1` (`ListView`) |
| `lookup.recordCount` | ar | `COUNT سجل` | `عدد السجلات: COUNT` | `totalCount === 1` (`RecordPickerDialog`) |
| `detail.reactionCount` | ar | `EMOJI COUNT تفاعلات` | `EMOJI عدد التفاعلات: COUNT` | `reaction.count === 1` (`ReactionPicker`) |
| `collaboration.presentUserCount` | ar | `COUNT مستخدمين متواجدين` | `عدد المستخدمين المتواجدين: COUNT` | `users.length === 1` (`PresenceAvatars`) |
| `collaboration.moreUserCount` | ar | `COUNT مستخدمين آخرين` | `عدد المستخدمين الآخرين: COUNT` | `overflowCount === 1` (`PresenceAvatars`) |
| `search.itemsAvailable` | ar | `COUNT عناصر متاحة` | `عدد العناصر المتاحة: COUNT` | `allItems.length === 1` (`SearchResultsPage`) |

COUNT and EMOJI stand for the i18next double-brace placeholders.

- The `ru` value matches `ru` `lookup.recordCount`, which already read `Записей: COUNT`. The `ar` values use the `عدد …: COUNT` shape of objectui#10242.
- The card's eighth row, `ar` `detail.revisionFieldsChanged`, is no longer in the tree. The key and its only consumer, `PointInTimeRestore`, were deleted by objectui#10453 (`0348bc9`, an ancestor of this branch's base). So seven values change, not eight.
- The pending `.changeset/9664-search-items-available-plural.md`: its last sentence said the `ar` value "uses the same noun pair that `ar`'s `common.itemCount`/`itemCountOne` already uses". After objectui#10242 and this change that is no longer true, so the sentence is reworded (triage execution note). Its front matter is unchanged. `check-changeset-overwrite` reports this edit as intended: case 2, prose correction.
- `.changeset/10425-ru-ar-count-labels.md`: `@object-ui/i18n: patch`.

## Pins

- **New: `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/countLabels.ruAr-10425.test.tsx`**, beside the objectui#10242 pin and in the same shape. It boots a real i18next from `createI18n` in the session's language, with `t` not mocked. Each consumer is rendered for real: the `ListView` record-count bar, the `RecordPickerDialog` count line, the `ReactionPicker` chip, the `PresenceAvatars` group name and overflow tooltip, and the `SearchResultsPage` browse count. The representative counts are `ru` 2 / 5 / 21 and `ar` 2 / 3 / 11, and the file asserts their `Intl.PluralRules` categories. Controls are `en`, the singular halves, and the `ru` values this change leaves alone (`lookup.recordCount`, `presentUserCount`, `moreUserCount`). Pack-level: each changed value ends in a colon and the count, and differs from its One half.
- **Flipped: `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/searchItemsAvailable-plural-9664.test.ts`**. The `ar` row of its `PLURAL` table now holds the new value, so the pin still does work, and its two comments about the `ar` noun pair are updated to match. Nothing was deleted.

## Reverse verification (one-off, not kept as a test)

Run at fix commit `e9e5896`, with the fix already committed. Both packs went back to base `111fa4c` (`git checkout BASE -- ru.ts ar.ts`), under a `trap` restore.

- The mutation reached disk: `grep -c` found the new `ar` value `عدد السجلات: COUNT` 0 times.
- The mutated run of the new pin plus the 9664 pin went red: exit 1, 25 failed and 44 passed.
  - 24 of the 25 are the new pin's rows, one per changed value and count: `ru` list bar at 2 / 5 / 21, and `ar` list bar, picker, chip, presence name, overflow tooltip and browse count at 2 / 3 / 11. The rest of the 24 are the two named-defect tests and the count-invariance test.
  - The 25th is the 9664 pin's `ar defines both halves` row.
  - Every control row stayed green.
- The restore was `git checkout HEAD -- ...`. Both files' `git hash-object` matched the HEAD blobs, and `git diff HEAD` was empty.

## Local verification, at head `574169b` (after merging `origin/main` `fee1da5`, which contains objectui#10534)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/i18n/` plus the four app-shell pins (`countLabels.ruAr-10425`, `countLabels.ruAr-10242`, `SearchResultsPage.itemsAvailablePlural-9664`, `SearchResultsPage.resultsCountPlural-10024`): `Test Files 75 passed (75)`, `Tests 1282 passed (1282)`, exit 0.
- Each of these exited 0: `pnpm check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (`VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `changeset:check`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check-vi-mock-specifiers`, `check-vi-mock-inherit` and `check-changeset-overwrite` (report-only).
- ESLint on the four changed TS files: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` reports 4 files, 0 errors and 0 warnings. The config is `typescript-eslint` `recommended`, with no type-aware parser options, so this diff cannot change the verdict on any file it does not touch. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check`: exit 0. It was run after building its dependency closure (`@object-ui/i18n^...`). `tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes the 9664 test and both packs.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0 at `35c233b`, after a turbo build of the 29-package `@object-ui/app-shell^...` closure. `--listFilesOnly` includes the new pin (1 of 4635 files). It was not re-run after the second `origin/main` merge, which does not change this diff.

## Acceptance notes

- `ru` `search.itemsAvailable` (`COUNT доступно`) is unchanged. It states no noun, so there is no word to agree with the number. This is the `NO_SINGULAR_FORM` reasoning in the 9664 pin.
- `ru` and `ar` `detail.relatedRecords` carry the same one-noun-form value, but no call site reads that pair. The only hits are its defaults-map row and comments. It has no pull, so it is left alone.
- `console.objectView.recordCount` is a separate defect, reported to the seat and not changed here. It is one key with no One sibling and no switch, read by the `ObjectView` record-count footer. A real i18next in `en` returns `1 records` at count 1.
